o: Ya no me quitan los ojos de encima, como si sucediera lo que parecen desear: que esté rabioso.
t: Now they won't take their eyes off me, as if what they seem to want were happening: that I should be rabid.

o: ¡Cómo es posible tanta estupidez en dos personas sensatas!
t: How is it possible for two sensible people to be so stupid!

o: Ahora no disimulan más, y hablan precipitadamente en voz alta de mí; pero, no sé por qué, no puedo entender una palabra.
t: Now they no longer hide it, and they speak hastily about me out loud; but, for some reason, I can't understand a single word.

o: En cuanto llego cesan de golpe, y apenas me alejo un paso recomienza el vertiginoso parloteo.
t: As soon as I arrive they stop abruptly, and the moment I step away the dizzy chatter starts again.

o: No he podido contenerme y me he vuelto con rabia:--¡Pero hablen, hablen delante, que es menos cobarde!
t: I couldn't hold back and I turned around angrily: "But talk, talk right in front of me, that's less cowardly!"

o: No he querido oir lo que han dicho y me he ido.
t: I didn't want to hear what they said, so I left.

o: ¡Ya no es vida la que llevo!
t: This is no life I'm living!
